content: Advent – The Coming There are doors in your mind, meant to stay closed.. . The Triangle Book Series (POSSIBLE) Five Civilians take a weekend boat ride into the depths of the Bermuda triangle , during  their  weekend a strange storm overtakes the boat as the compass goes nuts and electronics are rendered useless. Jack Moran,  Small-town  cop and one of the childhood friends sees something in the strange blue fog that overtakes the rented vessel.  Quickly the storm ends and everything clears up. Jack convinces himself that whatever he saw was simply a figment of his imagination.  Upon returning home he  begins  to experience strange  occurrences ,  his sight is  changing,  and he begins to think he can read minds, within a few weeks Jack is faster, stronger and smarter  than  ever, along with odd physical changes.  After going to the doctors and getting a clean bill of health he suddenly finds himself being followed,  is  it paranoia or is he really being followed.  Soon Jack finds himself hunted by his own government, some of his friends have gone missing and others simply have gone off the radar he needs to find out what is happening to him and what the government has in mind for these changes he now finds himself going through.  Targeted by the Government, Corporations and Interested parties, those who have not gone missing are thrust back together and they are running out of time to get to the bottom of this strange mystery.  What they find will shock the whole planet.  The Triangle is a Portal H umans  have been studied for nearly a century by an alien race determined to help mankind  survive its own planetary destruction .  The Changes were given to them During the trip, the aliens decide to test a biological  solution  to alter mankind giving us the ability to survive our own planets end. What they have done makes us stronger, faster, smarter  giving humans a better chance to survive the dying planet.  Corporations are hunting them Two  Biotech  Pharmacies, will stop at nothing to get ahold of the small group of meta humans ,  they  will unlock the groups secrets even if it means killing them  The Government sees them as a threat The government will stop at nothing to possess the group of meta humans, not only seeing them as a threat, but a potential solution to super soldiers. There is nowhere to  hide,  nowhere to run .  .  Jack Moran Small town Cop from Nashua NH Jack is an avid fisherman and sees the weekend as a way to reconnect with old school friends, his along with Will Turner and Robert Weeks are ex US army infantry and met during Afghanistan .  Will Turner FBI Agent and army  buddy?   Will is an FBI special agent and friend from the army days . Robert Weeks Bar Owner, Boston MA Robert always dreamed of owning a bar, after an IED took out his legs Robert took the small pension the army offered and opened the bar, he was barely staying above  water  but  Robert  “Ripper” Weeks could not be happier .
